defect.reproducer: Launch with subscriber_reliability:=reliable and record:=false. Topic discovery succeeds, but reliable echo times out with exit code 124. An independent best_effort observer simultaneously receives poses.
defect.root_cause: pose_relay offers BEST_EFFORT reliability. A subscriber requesting RELIABLE cannot match that publisher. Discovery still lists both endpoints; their RELIABILITY policies are incompatible.
defect.proof_after: Restart with subscriber_reliability:=best_effort and record:=true. The actual subscriber logs its first pose, CLI echo succeeds and patrol moves the turtle. Stop the live launch and replay that one MCAP with the best_effort override: reliable still times out, best_effort receives poses, and no live motion commands are published.
